Info

Parameter bundle holding controllers and transport channel for jog operations.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.manipulator.jog.controllers_bundle.JogControllersBundle(*, raw_channel: IRawChannel, motion_controller: IMotionController, jog_controller: IJogController, tool_controller: IToolController, query_controller: IQueryController)[source]¶

Bases: object

Bundle containing controllers and transport channel for manual jog controls.

It defines:

attributes:
raw_channel - Raw communication transport channel.
motion_controller - Motion activation and homing controller.
jog_controller - Manual relative axis movement controller.
tool_controller - End-effector pneumatic and valve controller.
query_controller - Robot state inquiry controller.
